<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use Database\Factories\CampusFactory;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema;
use Tests\TestCase;

class AuthRegisterMultiBranchesTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    public function test_teacher_register_with_multi_branches_links_user_campus_and_teacher_branches(): void
    {
        if (!Schema::hasTable('teacher_branches')) {
            $this->markTestSkipped('teacher_branches table missing');
        }

        $home = CampusFactory::new()->create();
        $other = CampusFactory::new()->create();

        $this->postJson('/api/v1/auth/register', [
            'name' => 'Multi Branch Teacher',
            'email' => 'mbt@example.com',
            'password' => 'secret',
            'role' => 'teacher',
            'branch_id' => $home->id,
            'multi_branches' => [$other->id],
        ])->assertStatus(201);

        $userId = DB::table('User')->where('LoginName', 'mbt@example.com')->value('id');
        $this->assertNotNull($userId);

        $this->assertDatabaseHas('UserCampus', [
            'UserID' => $userId,
            'CampusID' => $home->id,
        ]);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('UserCampus', [
            'UserID' => $userId,
            'CampusID' => $other->id,
        ]);

        $this->assertDatabaseHas('teacher_branches', [
            'teacher_id' => $userId,
            'branch_id' => $home->id,
        ]);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('teacher_branches', [
            'teacher_id' => $userId,
            'branch_id' => $other->id,
        ]);
    }

    public function test_teacher_register_rejects_unknown_multi_branch(): void
    {
        $home = CampusFactory::new()->create();

        $this->postJson('/api/v1/auth/register', [
            'name' => 'Bad Multi',
            'email' => 'badmb@example.com',
            'password' => 'secret',
            'role' => 'teacher',
            'branch_id' => $home->id,
            'multi_branches' => [999_999],
        ])->assertStatus(422)
            ->assertJsonFragment(['message' => '跨校分校不存在']);
    }

    public function test_director_register_ignores_multi_branches(): void
    {
        $a = CampusFactory::new()->create();
        $b = CampusFactory::new()->create();

        $this->postJson('/api/v1/auth/register', [
            'name' => 'Director Only',
            'email' => 'dironly@example.com',
            'password' => 'secret',
            'role' => 'director',
            'branch_id' => $a->id,
            'multi_branches' => [$b->id],
        ])->assertStatus(201);

        $userId = DB::table('User')->where('LoginName', 'dironly@example.com')->value('id');

        $this->assertDatabaseHas('UserCampus', [
            'UserID' => $userId,
            'CampusID' => $a->id,
        ]);
        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('UserCampus', [
            'UserID' => $userId,
            'CampusID' => $b->id,
        ]);
    }
}

content.text:
## 已完成內容

### 後端 `AuthController::register`
- 新增驗證：`multi_branches` 為可選整數陣列。
- 逐一檢查跨校 ID 是否存在，無效則回傳 **422**、`跨校分校不存在`。
- **僅老師**（`role: teacher`）會把 `branch_id` 與 `multi_branches` 合併去重後寫入 `UserCampus`，並在存在 `teacher_branches` 表時一併寫入（與原本單一分校邏輯相同，只是分校集合變大）。
- **主任註冊**仍只使用 `branch_id`，忽略 `multi_branches`（避免誤用公開註冊擴權）。

### 前端 `Register.vue`
- 在「預設分校」下方增加 **跨校支援（可複選）**：列出**除預設分校以外**的分校，用 chip 勾選。
- 切換預設分校時，會自動從跨校勾選中移除新選到的預設分校，避免重複。
- 送出時透過既有的 `supabase.auth.signUp` 帶上 `multi_branches`（`signUp` 本來就會 POST 此欄位，後端先前未處理）。

### 測試
- 新增 `tests/Feature/AuthRegisterMultiBranchesTest.php`：驗證 `UserCampus`、無效跨校、主任忽略 `multi_branches`。

前端已執行 **`npm run deploy`** 並完成建置複製。

---

老師在註冊時可選「主要分校」＋「其他可支援分校」；審核流程仍與原本相同（`UserCampus.Approved` 等），主任通過後這些關聯才會視為正式生效。若你希望連同 `teacher_branches` 在測試資料庫也強制驗證，需要在專案裡補上對應的 migration（目前正式環境有表、SQLite 測試沒有表時會跳過 `teacher_branches` 斷言）。
